definitions.explanation: A party or gathering held to welcome a new member, colleague, or guest. Composed of 歓迎 (welcome) + 会 (gathering). Very common in Japanese workplace and school culture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歓迎会|かんげいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: We're holding a welcome party for the new employees.

examples.japanese: {歓迎会|かんげいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幹事|かんじ}→幹事：16378_kanji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}された。
examples.english: I was put in charge of organizing the welcome party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学生|りゅうがくせい}→留学生：02986_ryuugakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歓迎会|かんげいかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{自己紹介|じこしょうかい}→自己紹介：12331_jikoshoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられていた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: At the welcome party for exchange students, time was set aside for self-introductions.

notes:
USAGE:
{歓迎会|かんげいかい} is a fixture of Japanese organizational culture. Companies, schools, and clubs regularly hold them when new members join, especially in April at the start of the fiscal and academic year. They are often combined with ⟦{送別会|そうべつかい}→送別会：16080_soubetsukai⟧ (farewell party) as ⟦{歓送迎会|かんそうげいかい}→歓送迎会：30247_kansougeikai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歓迎会|かんげいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (hold a welcome party)
- {歓迎会|かんげいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幹事|かんじ}→幹事：16378_kanji⟧ (party organizer)
- {歓迎会|かんげいかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧ (attend a welcome party)
- ⟦{歓送迎会|かんそうげいかい}→歓送迎会：30247_kansougeikai⟧ (combined welcome and farewell party)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{送別会|そうべつかい}→送別会：16080_soubetsukai⟧ is a farewell party for someone leaving. ⟦{懇親会|こんしんかい}→懇親会：17926_konshinkai⟧ is a social mixer or get-together, broader than a welcome event.
